text_block_list.text:
One day, while chatting online with Loves 
Only You's "commu-members"—

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanna, like, give Loves-chan 
some kind of reward, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"True. She's working super hard, after 
all. Streams all the time for us too. 
Kinda makes you wanna do something for her 
for a change."
choice_data_list: How about giving a present or something?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds lovely. How about reaching 
out to all community members to see who 
would like to contribute a gift?"

Since we're doing it, I want to make it 
part of a stream project. I'll keep the 
plan secret from Loves Only You until the 
day of, making it a surprise.

Now is the time to do my best as a 
'bridge.' I have to deliver the community 
members' feelings straight to her!

—And so, while collecting gifts from 
everyone in the community, I also prepared 
a message board on behalf of all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today's a special plan brought in by 
Trainer-kun, so I haven't heard a single 
thing about it... Wonder what it is?
choice_data_list:
Actually... it's a present from the 
commu-members!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today's a special plan brought in by 
Trainer-chan, so I haven't heard a single 
thing about it... Wonder what it is?
choice_data_list:
Actually... it's a present from the 
commu-members!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

First, I will read aloud a message from 
all the committee members.

"‘To Loves-chan, who is always working so 
hard with training and streams. To our 
darling full of love, we'd like to give 
you a tangible gift once in a while.’"

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Please take this~~!!" "Thank you for 
everything!" "Packed with lots of love~♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! Thank you...! To think you'd 
give me a surprise like this...
choice_data_list: Now for the next one, from Ms. Quitter!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Here's a new chocolate from a famous 
chocolatier. You mentioned in your chat 
stream the other day that you were curious 
about it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That's totally that, the super melty 
chocolate terrine...!! Eeeep, I'm so 
happy~~♡♡♡
choice_data_list:
This one is from "Middle-Aged Muscle 
Enthusiast"!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
""These are supplemental snacks for 
training that I found. If you'd like, you 
can have them alongside your daily 
training.""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, isn't this the new energy bar? 
Ehehe~ I'm so happy! Mr. Middle-Aged 
Lifter, let's eat this together and do our 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"And from me, a fighting manga I 
recommend! It's sprinkled with fighting 
game references, so it's pretty fun. Be 
sure to check it out when you need a 
break!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'm so excited! Maybe I'll stream 
my impressions once I read it? Thank you 
so much~!

With this, I've handed out gifts to all 
the committee members. The surprise was a 
huge success!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Any word from Ms. Bridge?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Is there nothing? A present from you, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Is there nothing? A present from you, I 
mean.

...Come to think of it, I hadn't thought 
about that. My main focus was acting as a 
"bridge" to convey the comm-members' 
feelings to her.

“Still, we came up with the message from 
the whole community together, and I put my 
own feelings into the gift from everyone, 
too.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Trainer-kun, you are always the 
precious bridge that connects me to 
everyone. I'm so grateful to you for that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Trainer-chan, you are always 
the precious bridge that connects me to 
everyone. I'm so grateful to you for that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: However, that's beside the point!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while... at a time like this, I 
want to hear how you really feel too, 
Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while... at a time like this, I 
want to hear how you really feel too, 
Trainer-chan."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just like everyone else's— I want to 
properly receive your love too."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just like everyone else's— I want to 
properly receive your love too."

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly! Stop acting like you're an 
outcast all by yourself, sheesh!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you didn't prepare anything?! I 
totally thought you'd have something for 
me too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: See, everyone else says so too. —Right?
choice_data_list:
...I'll make sure to prepare a proper 
present!

text_block_list.text:
I'm part of the community supporting her 
too. Not just as a 'bridge,' but as a fan, 
I have to convey my feelings!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I'm really looking forward to it!
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you. I wonder what's inside~?

Since this gift idea started out as a 
reward for all her hard work, I figured 
I'd simply go with something she loves.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Isn't this that super famous, 
super expensive one? It says "Jam Set" on 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This would taste so good spread on bread 
or snacks~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I got such a great reward. Thank 
you, Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I got such a great reward. Thank 
you, Trainer-chan♡

I am in a position to support her most 
closely. If so, I thought of finding 
something that could help even a little 
with her daily activities.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the newest model of lapel mic?! 
The frequency range is so wide, and the 
sound is super clear, isn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! I heard this was super popular 
and always sold out, but...
choice_data_list: I somehow managed to find it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—! ...Fufu, look at you trying so hard for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I felt all your love, 
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I felt all your love, 
Trainer-chan.
